CustomField.formula: IF ( OR ( Combined_Weighted_Final_Grade_Values__c = 0, Total_Credits_Earned__c = 0 ), NULL, Combined_Weighted_Final_Grade_Values__c / Total_Credits_Earned__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Displays the year-to-date weighted GPA for all completed courses in a single school year. The value in this field displays on report cards in the Weighted GPA field.
CustomField.label: Final Weighted GPA Value
